title.en: 2-dome no Jinsei, to Omottara, Jitsu wa 3-dome Datta

altTitles.ja: ２度目の人生、と思ったら、実は３度目だった。
２度目の人生、と思ったら、実は３度目だった。～歴史知識と内政努力で不幸な歴史の改変に挑みます～@COMIC

altTitles.ja-ro: 2-dome no Jinsei, to Omottara, Jitsu wa 3-dome Datta: Rekishi Chishiki to Naisei Doryoku de Fukou na Rekishi no Kaihen ni Idomimasu

altTitles.en: My Second Life... or So I Thought, but It's Actually My Third Life
My Second Life... or So I Thought, but It's Actually My Third Life: Using My Knowledge of History and Domestic Policies to Change the Unfortunate History

description.en:
"This time, I'll protect my happy family for sure!"

Takhir, a young baron who had lost his beloved family, was unable to do anything and thus labeled as an incompetent. However, as he was dying, his time-space magic suddenly manifested and he regained the memories of his previous life before being transported back to his childhood?!

He no longer faltered in the face of war or the epidemic. He vowed to use his revived modern knowledge to improve their level of civilization... and to change his family's fate!

By using his knowledge of the future, he was determined to reduce the damage caused by the poor harvest and flood, while doing everything he could to get talented individuals on his side, strengthening the Solis barony!

By moving without concerning himself with the gaze of others, he would go beyond the Kair Kingdom, altering history across the entire continent!

With his "family-first principle", the child prodigy would alter his depressing fate! His unprecedently large rebellion story begins!
